PIC_MCC_3D real macro-particles — Langmuir slosh

Every dot IS a PIC macro-particle (leapfrog positions; color = v_z, blue−/red+). Cold Langmuir slosh in a periodic neutralising jelly — the package's frequency-gate configuration made visible. Reduced-density cm box: the honest 3-D PIC regime, not the laser chamber (plan §3). Positions are uint8-quantized here — exact values live in particles_data.npz.
